Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 12172-1987 



Indian Standard 
SPECIFICATION FOR DISTRACTION CERVICAL COLLAR 



( Reaffirmed 1997) 



1. Scope — Specifies requirements for distraction type cervical collar. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — The shape and dimensions of the collar shall be as per the 
requirement. However, a typical collar is shown in Fig. 1. 

3. Material 

3.1 frame — The frame of the collar shall be made of mild steel wire rod conforming to IS : 7887- 
1975 'Specification for mild steel wire rod for general engineering purposes'. 

3.2 Padding — ShaW be made of latex rubber conforming to IS : 1741-1960 'Specification for latex 
foam rubber products'. 

3,2 Leather — Ihe leather covering used shall conform to IS : 3982-1966 'Specification for 
sheepskin leather for orthopaedic linings. 

3.4 Sewing Thread — Cotton sewing thread of 60s/6 (lOOd texX 6) conforming to Variety No. 31 of 
IS : 1720-1978 Specification for cotton sewing threads (second revision)'. 



SHEEP LEATHER COVERING 



SCREWS AND NUTS

IS : 12172-1987 

3.5 Fasteners — Ends of the collar shall have fasteners conforming to IS : 8156-1981 'Specification 
for fasteners, hook and loop tape, synthetic (first revision)'. The tape shall have the minimum width 
of 2.5 cm and overlap of 2.5 cm. 

4. Requirements 

4.1 Distraction cervical collar shall be tailored neatly. 

4.2 The frame of the collar shall be made of mild steel and the metallic frame shall be padded with 
latex foam rubber and covered with sheepskin leather. 

4.3 The leather used for covering shall be reasonably strong/ possess smooth surface to avoid 
chaffing of the skin when in contact, durable and sweat resistant. Besides, it shall be sufficiently 
flexible so that the lining can readily take to the shape and form of the collar. 

4.4 The leather shall be dye finished, preferably and the dyes employed shall have good fastness to 
sweat. In case, the leather is to be pigment finished, the pigments used shall be non-irritant. 

4.5 Sweat Contrast Grading — Colour fastness after 1024 revolutions for dry rubbing shall be 5 and 
for wet rubbing 4, when tested according to LF 9 of IS : 6191-197T 'Methods of micro-biological, 
colour fastness and microscopical tests for leather'. 

4.6 The collar shall be provided with screws and nuts (as shown in Fig. 1 ) for adjusting the height as 
per requirement. 

4.7 The collar, when worn, shall not give any uncomfortable feeling. 

5. Marking 

5.1 The collar shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark. 
5,1.1 Standard i\/larking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

6. Packaging — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



EXP LAN ATOR Y N OTE 

Distraction type cervical collar is an excellent appliance used for cervical fractures where 
ambulatory treatment is required, or in other cases where it is necessary to immobilise the head.
